Full Functional Scope

Engineered for pharmaceutical compliance

Every pill accounted for. Eliminate manual drug registers, prevent expiry losses, and ensure complete transparency across your dispensaries.

Batch & Expiry Date Tracking

Granular lot/batch number tracking with automated FIFO inventory dispatch and early expiry notification alerts.

Prescription Dispensing Engine

Digital prescription verification, dosage instructions, patient medication history, and refill tracking.

Fast Pharmacy Point-of-Sale

High-speed barcode scanner checkout for OTC medicines, toiletries, and prescription drugs with receipt printing.

Regulated Substance Audit

Secure tracking for controlled medications with strict pharmacist authorization logs and regulatory compliance registers.

Generic Drug Substitution

Instant suggestions for approved active-ingredient generic alternatives when brand-name drugs are out of stock.

Supplier & Wholesaler Procurement

Automated purchase orders (PO) triggered when shelf quantities reach safety par levels, with GRN price verification.

Insurance & Co-Pay Billing

Direct integration with health insurance schemes, client eligibility checks, and co-payment receipt splitting.

Multi-Dispensary Centralization

Connect hospital pharmacies, community branch stores, and central pharmaceutical warehouses into one live database.

Temperature & Storage Monitoring

Log cold-chain storage parameters and receive alerts for sensitive vaccines and biologics.

Executive Profitability Reports

Item-level gross margins, daily dispensary cash reconciliations, fast-moving drug velocity, and tax statements.
